title.en: Chapter 20 — All From the Same Mould

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: رحنا على المحل اللي باع التماثيل، وصاحبه قال: ست نسخ.
sentences.en: We went to the shop that had sold the busts, and its owner said: six copies.
I bought them from a plaster works in Stepney.

sentences.ar: تلاتة بعتهم هون، وتلاتة بمحل تاني.
sentences.en: Three I sold here, and three at another shop.

sentences.ar: وشاف صورة الميت، وقال: هاد بيبو!
sentences.en: And he saw the dead man's photograph, and said: that is Beppo!
He worked for me!
He left a year ago.
And Holmes said: Beppo?
No, this is not Beppo.
And showed him the photograph of the ape-faced man.
The shopkeeper said: that is Beppo.
The dead man I do not know.

sentences.ar: وبمصنع الجبس، نفس الشي: بيبو اشتغل هنا، وكان شاطر.
sentences.en: And at the plaster works, the same: Beppo worked here, and was skilled.

sentences.ar: وبعدين انحبس، لأنه طعن واحد بالشارع.
sentences.en: And then was jailed, for stabbing a man in the street.
And came out of prison two weeks ago.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: وإيمتى عملتوا الست نسخ؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: and when did you make the six copies?
The manager said: a year ago.

sentences.ar: بنفس اليوم اللي انحبس فيه بيبو.
sentences.en: The same day Beppo was arrested.
Holmes said as we drove: it is done.
The picture is complete.
I said: complete?
I see nothing.

sentences.ar: قال: بيبو عمل شي بيوم قبل ما ينحبس.
sentences.en: He said: Beppo did something the day before he was arrested.
And hid it in a bust, while the plaster was still soft.
And he was jailed a year, and the busts were sold.

sentences.ar: وطلع، وصار يدور عليها، واحد واحد.
sentences.en: And he came out, and began hunting them, one by one.
I said: and what did he hide?

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: واطسون، بتتذكر لؤلؤة بورجيا؟
sentences.en: Holmes said: Watson, do you remember the Borgia pearl?

sentences.ar: انسرقت من فندق من سنة، من غرفة أميرة إيطالية.
sentences.en: Stolen from a hotel a year ago, from an Italian princess's room.
And she had a maid, and no one found it.
And the maid has a brother.
Named Beppo.
Holmes said: and now, two busts remain.
One in Reading, one in Chiswick.
And the pearl is in one of them.
Lestrade said: we go and take them.
Holmes said: no.
We wait for Beppo.
Tonight, in Chiswick.

sentences.ar: وكتب برقية للي بريدينغ: ما تبيع تمثالك لحدا.
sentences.en: And he wrote a telegram to the one in Reading: sell your bust to no one.
I said: why Chiswick?
He said: because it is nearer.
And Beppo is in a hurry.
And I know he is in a hurry, because he killed.

sentences.ar: والميت، صاحبه، أو شريكه، اللي كان بده يشاركه اللؤلؤة.
sentences.en: And the dead man, his friend, or his partner, who wanted a share of the pearl.

sentences.ar: بتشيزيك، قعدنا بحديقة البيت، ورا شجرة، بالعتمة.
sentences.en: In Chiswick, we sat in the garden of the house, behind a tree, in the dark.

sentences.ar: البيت مضوي، وبعدين انطفى، وصار الليل.
sentences.en: The house lit, and then dark, and night came.

sentences.ar: وبعد ساعة، ظل مرق عالحيط، ووصل عالشباك، وفتحه.
sentences.en: And after an hour, a shadow passed along the wall, reached the window, and opened it.

sentences.ar: وفات، وخرج بعد دقيقة، وبإيده شي أبيض.
sentences.en: And went in, and came out a minute later, something white in his hand.

sentences.ar: ومشى للضو، عند الباب، ورفع التمثال، وكسره على الدرج.
sentences.en: And walked to the light, at the door, raised the bust, and smashed it on the step.
And knelt, and began searching among the pieces.

sentences.ar: وهولمز نط عليه من ورا، وليستراد من قدام، وأنا مسكت إجريه.
sentences.en: And Holmes leapt on him from behind, and Lestrade from the front, and I caught his legs.
His face like an ape's, his eyebrows thick.
Beppo.
And among the pieces, nothing.
Holmes said: so, Reading.
